GRAPH_COMPLETION.sql_skeleton:
WITH ChannelCourierConcentration AS (
    -- Unicommerce OMS
    SELECT DISTINCT
        sales_channel AS channel_name,
        courier_partner AS courier_name,
        order_id
    FROM
        zs_observe.unicommerce
    WHERE
        group_level_id = '22'
        AND is_active = true -- Inferred filter

    UNION ALL

    -- Increff OMS/WMS
    SELECT DISTINCT
        sales_channel AS channel_name,
        courier_partner AS courier_name,
        order_id
    FROM
        zs_observe.increff_sales
    WHERE
        group_level_id = '22'
        AND is_active = true -- Inferred filter
)
SELECT
    channel_name,
    courier_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS total_orders
FROM
    ChannelCourierConcentration
WHERE
    channel_name IS NOT NULL AND courier_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
    channel_name, courier_name
ORDER BY
    channel_name, total_orders DESC;
